subject: Privacy & compliance follow-up: DPA routing and SCC module selection
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Voss <elena.voss@medprime.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy & compliance follow-up: DPA routing and SCC module selection

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture:    

Call highlights:
- MedPrime needs: DPA + SCCs for EU data flows, SOC 2 evidence, and answers to your vendor security questionnaire.
- Data residency: primary workload will be in eu-west-1; MedPrime expects subcontractor disclosure for any inference partners.
- Role mapping: from our discussion you intend to treat Redwood as a processor — please confirm.

Redwood status (summary):
- SOC 2: Type II in production for core control set; annual audit scope being expanded to additional infra in Q3 2027. We can share the current SOC 2 report under NDA.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA template and support SCC Module 2 (standard contractual clauses) or Model Clauses. We typically propose processor DPA + SCC Module 2 for EU transfers unless the customer requires otherwise.

Action items / asks for MedPrime:
1) Please confirm whether you will affirm Redwood as a processor (so we can route the DPA appropriately).
2) Confirm any strict data residency or subprocessors beyond AWS eu-west-1.
3) Please send your vendor security questionnaire (I’ll route to Priyom to complete).

Attachments: redwood_dpa_summary_v1.pdf — short DPA options + summary of SCC modules we propose.

Next suggested steps:
- You send questionnaire (or confirm we should use the Vendor Security Questionnaire attached in your systems).
- We respond with completed questionnaire + redlined DPA (if needed) within 3 business days of receiving your doc.
- Legal sync (Laura) if MedPrime needs changes to the SCC module selection.

If useful I can tee up a short 20-minute legal handoff next week. Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

- Primary requirement: DPA + SCCs for EU -> US transfers (Module 2 or equivalent).

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Privacy & compliance follow-up: DPA routing and SCC module selection

Thanks — quick legal guidance and recommended approach:    

1) Role mapping: treat Redwood as a processor in the DPA (matches Jonas/Elena). That is the simplest and most accurate mapping given Redwood processes on behalf of MedPrime.

2) SCC/module: recommend SCC Module 2 (controller-to-processor transfers) or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses equivalent. Module 2 aligns with the request and is our standard for EU transfers when the customer is the controller. If MedPrime requires additional safeguards (e.g., localization clauses) we can discuss but Module 2 should be acceptable.

3) Subprocessors & data residency: provide a complete subprocessors list (AWS eu-west-1 primary; any inference partners used for optimization must be disclosed). For partners that perform inference on customer data, include subprocessors, region, and purpose in a short appendix.

4) SOC 2 and evidence: we can share the latest SOC 2 Type II report under NDA and provide a summary timeline for the Q3 scope expansion. Priyom should include a one-page summary in the questionnaire response.

5) Timing & deliverables: propose we return: (a) completed vendor questionnaire; (b) redwood_dpa_summary_v1.pdf and draft DPA with SCC Module 2 marked; (c) subprocessors appendix — within 3 business days of receiving the questionnaire (target: 2027-05-12/2027-05-13). If MedPrime needs additional redlines, escalate and we’ll schedule a legal sync.

Attachments: none internal — see redwood_dpa_summary_v1.pdf (already sent to customer).

Next step: Priyom, please confirm you can turn the questionnaire by EOD 2027-05-12. Jonas, suggest offering Elena a 30-minute legal handoff on 2027-05-13 if they want to go through SCC specifics.

Best,
Laura Bennett
